@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+from _pytest.config.findpaths import load_config_dict_from_file
+from _pytest.pathlib import absolutepath
+
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from _pytest.config.findpaths import ConfigDict
+
+
+def local_config_discovery(
+    invocation_dir: Path,
+    args: Iterable[Path],
+) -> tuple[Path | None, Path | None, ConfigDict]:
+    """Find pytest configuration, checking pytest-local.ini first in each directory."""
+    config_names = (
+        "pytest-local.ini",
+        "pytest.ini",
+        ".pytest.ini",
+        "pyproject.toml",
+        "tox.ini",
+        "setup.cfg",
+    )
+    args = [arg for arg in args if not str(arg).startswith("-")]
+    if not args:
+        args = [invocation_dir]
+    found_pyproject_toml: Path | None = None
+    for arg in args:
+        argpath = absolutepath(arg)
+        for base in (argpath, *argpath.parents):
+            for config_name in config_names:
+                path = base / config_name
+                if path.is_file():
+                    if config_name == "pyproject.toml" and found_pyproject_toml is None:
+                        found_pyproject_toml = path
+                    ini_config = load_config_dict_from_file(path)
+                    if ini_config is not None:
+                        return base, path, ini_config
+    if found_pyproject_toml is not None:
+        return found_pyproject_toml.parent, found_pyproject_toml, {}
+    return None, None, {}
diff --git a/testing/test_local_config_discovery.py b/testing/test_local_config_discovery.py

--- /dev/null
+++ b/testing/test_local_config_discovery.py
@@ -0,0 +1,65 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from _pytest.config.exceptions import UsageError
+from _pytest.config.findpaths import locate_config
+from _pytest.local_config_discovery import local_config_discovery
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("args", [(), (Path("--verbose"),)])
+def test_local_config_takes_precedence(tmp_path: Path, args: tuple[Path, ...]) -> None:
+    local_ini = tmp_path / "pytest-local.ini"
+    local_ini.write_text("[pytest]\nname = local\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    default_ini = tmp_path / "pytest.ini"
+    default_ini.touch()
+
+    assert local_config_discovery(tmp_path, iter(args)) == (
+        tmp_path,
+        local_ini,
+        {"name": "local"},
+    )
+    assert locate_config(tmp_path, args) == (tmp_path, default_ini, {})
+
+
+def test_nearer_config_wins_over_parent_local_config(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    (tmp_path / "pytest-local.ini").write_text("[pytest]\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    child = tmp_path / "tests"
+    child.mkdir()
+    default_ini = child / "pytest.ini"
+    default_ini.touch()
+
+    assert local_config_discovery(tmp_path, [child / "test_example.py"]) == (
+        child,
+        default_ini,
+        {},
+    )
+
+
+def test_local_config_without_pytest_section_is_skipped(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    (tmp_path / "pytest-local.ini").touch()
+    (tmp_path / "pyproject.toml").touch()
+    child = tmp_path / "tests"
+    child.mkdir()
+    tox_ini = child / "tox.ini"
+    tox_ini.write_text("[pytest]\nname = tox\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+    assert local_config_discovery(tmp_path, [tmp_path, child]) == (
+        child,
+        tox_ini,
+        {"name": "tox"},
+    )
+    assert local_config_discovery(tmp_path, [tmp_path]) == (
+        tmp_path,
+        tmp_path / "pyproject.toml",
+        {},
+    )
+
+
+def test_invalid_local_config_raises_usage_error(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
+    (tmp_path / "pytest-local.ini").write_text("[pytest\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    (tmp_path / "pytest.ini").touch()
+
+    with pytest.raises(UsageError, match=r"pytest-local\.ini:1:"):
+        local_config_discovery(tmp_path, [])
notes:
The new function checks pytest-local.ini first in each candidate directory and uses pytest’s existing parser and fallback rules. The existing locate_config is unchanged.
